name: Pigment Yellow 110
description: Pigment Yellow 110 (CAS 5590-18-1 ), an isoindolinone-based organic pigment, delivers a clean, greenish-yellow hue with outstanding heat stability and lightfastness. It is a high-performance colorant specified across demanding industrial applications where color retention under processing stress is a primary requirement for the final product. In plastics, it withstands the high processing temperatures of engineering polymers such as polyamide and polypropylene, maintaining hue integrity where lower-grade yellows fail. Coatings formulators use it in industrial and automotive finishes where exterior durability and resistance to UV degradation are critical to long-term product performance. In printing inks, particularly high-end packaging and specialty gravure applications, it delivers sharp, reproducible yellow tones with strong substrate adhesion and clarity. Rubber and elastomer compounders select it for coloring profiles, seals, and technical parts that undergo prolonged outdoor or thermal exposure during their service life. Pigment Yellow 110 is supplied as a dry powder, typically in press cake or flushed paste form for ink and coating applications to ensure optimal dispersion. Standard grades are available for plastics and coatings, with particle size and surface treatment varying by application. Technical-grade material is the established market form.
